### Christmas Carols: Joy to the World
Author: Randall Van Meggelen
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/articles/christmas-carols-joy-world
Passage: Psalm 98:1-9
Points:
- Isaac Watts based his classic hymn on Psalm 98 to declare that salvation belongs entirely to the Lord.
- The psalm outlines three redemptive movements fulfilled in Jesus: past salvation, present reign as King, and future return to judge with equity.
- Believers must look beyond a sentimental view of the Nativity to see Christ as the victorious warrior who defeats sin.
- God’s revealed righteousness and redemptive deeds demand a response of resounding joy from both humanity and creation.
- Daily and weekly praise offers believers a foretaste of the unending worship they will offer before God's throne.
